subject: Product timeline stress test and commitment summit
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-06-12 08:10 -0700
Subject: Product timeline stress test and commitment summit

Folks —

Ahead of next week’s QBR we need a short, aligned pack showing where the product/eng roadmap stands and what we can realistically commit to for the July launches. My ask: a single slide-level "readiness matrix" covering the next three major launches with clear ownership and the top 2 risks per launch.

Deliverables by EOD Tuesday (12 Jun):
- Stability matrix (owner/status/mitigation) — see attached stub.
- A concise timeline snapshot with any new slips annotated.
- One-line mitigation owners and ETA for fixes.

Attaching a draft stability_matrix.xlsx and timeline_snapshot.pdf for you to edit — please update the matrix directly. I’ll consolidate and send to Sales + Execs on Wed morning.

Key external ask: Carol at Acme asked for clarity on the GA date and what fallback plans exist if the model quantization runs into perf regressions. Can we list the fallback model variants and rollback plan in the matrix?

Thanks — Monica

[attachment: stability_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]
[attachment: timeline_snapshot.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-12 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Product timeline stress test and commitment summit

Monica —

Quick notes from Eng capacity and risk side (high level):
- Quantization work (Team: Serving Infra): risk = medium-high; impact = latency regression on long-tail prompts. Mitigation: parallel perf sweep + temporary rollback to FP16 variant; ETA for sweep = 5 business days.
- End-to-end integration test flakiness (Team: Integration): risk = medium; root cause = intermittent KV cache eviction under spike; mitigation = KV cache guard + load test tuning; ETA = 3 days.
- Feature toggles for progressive rollout are in place but we lack a deterministic canary metric for quality degradation — ops to own metric by Wed.

I updated the stability_matrix.xlsx with the above and added a column for "fallback_variant". Will add JIRA refs in the drive doc.

Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carol Smith <carol.smith@acme.com>
Date: 2028-06-12 14:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Product timeline stress test and commitment summit

Thanks Karthik — good, granular callouts. A few consolidation asks before I send the QBR pack:

1) Can we keep the external-facing slide to 3 bullets per launch: (a) current commitment date, (b) biggest risk + likelihood (low/med/high), (c) fallback plan and owner.
2) Monica: please produce a one-page "decision grid" that maps binary go/no-go triggers (SLOs, perf, test pass rate) to the action (proceed / partial rollout / delay).
3) Karthik/Laura: add explicit runbook links (internal) to the matrix for the two top risks per launch. Execs want to see that we have immediate remediation steps.

External note to Carol (cc'd): Acme — we will list the fallback variant for GA and the length of time we expect to keep it available if we detect regressions. Expect a consolidated note Wed AM.

I attached a short release_commitments.md draft with the recommended slide headings. Monica — I can take the first pass on layout if you want me to convert your consolidated inputs into the external slide.

Vivek

[attachment: release_commitments.md (md)]

On Tue, Jun 12, 2028 at 10:03 Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-13 09:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Product timeline stress test and commitment summit

Adding two operational blockers we surfaced in sprint planning:
- Infra quota contention in the EU staging region — this can delay validation for Launch B by 4–7 days. Mitigation: temporary validation in us-west cluster + parallel smoke tests in EU once quota frees. Owner: Laura / Ops.
- Third-party tokenizer update causing small diffs in token counts for edge prompts — impact = small but affects billing-sensitive tests. Mitigation: pin tokenizer at release branch until we can fully evaluate; ETA 2 days.

I updated the drive folder with the smoke-test checklist and added a short note under the matrix explaining the EU quota workaround. If we need to be conservative for the external commitment, call out a realistic buffer (7 days) for Launch B.

Laura

Ack — I will:
- Consolidate the matrix and produce the one-page decision grid (by 06/14 09:00 PT).
- Include the fallback variants and the conservative 7-day buffer language for Launch B.
- Share the final external slide deck with Carol and Execs Wed 07:30 PT.

If anything else pops up, flag in the drive and I’ll fold it into the pack.

Thanks — Monica
